name: CC MEETING - JUNE 5, 2018 - 5PM
agenda_text:
CC MEETING - JUNE 5, 2018 - 5PM
CC MEETING - JUNE 5, 2018 - 5PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
TUESDAY, JUNE 05, 2018
05:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 1426
www.cityofpalmdaleca.gov
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
SPEAKER FORMS: &nbspFor record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. ROLL CALL: MAYOR LEDFORD, MAYOR PRO TEM CARRILLO COUNCILMEMBERS HOFBAUER, BETTENCOURT, AND BISHOP
3. CLOSED SESSION – PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
4. PRESENTATION BY CITY ATTORNEY of the following item(s) to be discussed in Closed Session:
4.1 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel and to receive direction from the City Council regarding the following pending litigation to which the City is a party:
Dunnagan, et al. v. City of Lancaster, et al.
Los Angeles County Superior Court Case No. BC 615197
Celebron, et al. v. City of Lancaster, et al.
Los Angeles County Superior Court Case No. BC 615587
This closed session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Sections 54956.9(d)(1).
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits and weaknesses of this matter and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public.
4.2 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel and to receive direction from the City Council regarding the following pending litigation to which the City is a party:
Nicholas Tomaszewski v. City of Palmdale, et al.
Los Angeles County Superior Court Case No. MC 026 483
This closed session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Sections 54956.9(d)(1).
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits and weaknesses of this matter and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public.
4.3 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel regarding the following pending litigation to which the City is a party:
City of Palmdale v. Rodney Bruce, et al.
Los Angeles County Superior Court Case No. MC 027 808
This closed session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Sections 54956.9(a) and 54956.9(d)(1).
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits and weaknesses of these matters and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public.
5. CLOSED SESSION.
6. ANNOUNCEMENT BY CITY ATTORNEY of item(s) discussed in Closed Session.
7. NON-AGENDA ITEMS - PUBLIC COMMENTS:
8. ADJOURNMENT.
